fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 -shuffle=on ./internal/api -skip '^(TestReadBudget|TestReadBudgetApply|TestDriverPollIsCheap)$' passes twice in a row with different shuffle seeds; go vet ./internal/api is clean; grep shows no t.Setenv left in newSessionFixture and TestMain in internal/api/budget_test.go sets XDG_CACHE_HOME. Failure case: go test -trimpath -race -count=1 ./internal/api -run '^Test(Daemon|Feed|Usage|Session|ShipPrePush|Run|Handback|SpawnedSession|Abandon)' (the tests that swap package variables, runClock included via useClock, and run_handback_test.go's and run_spawned_test.go's tests, beside parallel ones) reports no data race. Speedup measure (orchestrator, quiet VM): /usr/bin/time -f '%e s' go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -skip '^(TestReadBudget|TestReadBudgetApply|TestDriverPollIsCheap)$' within 150 s (2026-11-15: 388 s). Touches internal/api/*_test.go only (session_test.go's newSessionFixture, budget_test.go's TestMain, and the tests marked parallel). Must not skip, delete or merge a test: go test -list '.*' ./internal/api counts the same tests as before.
fields.statement: internal/api's independent tests call t.Parallel(); the session fixture's cache folder moves to TestMain so its tests can too; a test that swaps a package variable (runClock, daemonTicker, daemonReexec and the like), calls t.Setenv or t.Chdir, uses run temp folders, or reads shared machine state stays serial, and a comment on each such test says why it must.
